summary: Governance/notification repair phase closing the notification asymmetry 113S/113T/113U/113V each documented and re-confirmed without repairing. Forensic finding: pcae skill invoke phase-finalization <phase-id> is Phase 64B.5's generic, read-only Skill Invocation Targeting preview -- it never imports notifications.py, never constructs a TelegramSink, never reads PCAE_NOTIFY_ENABLED, and is not part of the real dispatch path at all; its target_unresolved failures came from matching only against the frozen _CRI_KNOWN_PHASES roadmap registry (last extended around Phase 69P/64B.6E), confirmed live to fail for ordinary phase 113D identically to 113T/113U/113V -- special phase-ID shapes were never the actual variable. The real gap: pcae phase complete had no notification-dispatch idempotency guard, unlike pcae task finish --commit, which already carried a marker-file workaround. Repair: _sit_resolve_phase_target()/_sit_infer_target_type() (src/pcae/core/agent.py) now fall back to live repository state (latest.json, historical reports, quarantined reports, in-flight phase-completion metadata, PROJECT_STATUS.md current phase) and classify phase-shaped IDs via a new grammar supporting normal/multi-letter/dotted-numeric/dotted-letter-repair forms; a syntactically invalid ID is reported as invalid_phase_id_form, distinct from a well-formed but not-found target_unresolved. A new notification_dispatch_note clarifies the command never gates or reflects Telegram dispatch. pcae task finish --commit's marker-file idempotency logic is generalized into shared phase_reports.py functions and pcae phase complete gains the same guard: a repeated finalization for the same phase_id + commit is now a no-op with an explicit reason instead of a duplicate send; a new commit for the same phase still sends. pcae notify send-report --latest remains deliberately unguarded (manual resend workflow). 18 new focused tests; 5,674 pre-existing phase/task/notification/agent-skill-targeting tests re-run clean; fast_green 4,390/4,390; full suite 16,644/16,646 (2 pre-existing unrelated failures, hardcoded '112C' expectations documented since Phase 113X.2). No Repository Transition Validator integration (113W untouched). No Advisory Runtime/Runtime Snapshot/Runtime Context/Runtime Registry/Runtime Inspect/Permission Broker changes. No execution/authorization/plugin/Telegram-inbound/REST/Web-UI/Dashboard changes. Execution capability remains unavailable.
